caption: The drawing depicts a grayscale illustration of a statue featuring a male figure dressed in a long double-breasted coat, trousers, and shoes. The man is wearing a large-brimmed hat with three prominent upward-pointing sections, resembling a traditional fireman's hat. He is holding a trumpet or speaking horn with his right arm crossed in front of him, while his left hand rests at his side. The figure is standing on a pedestal with a hexagonal base above a larger, circular plinth. Attached to the pedestal, on the man's right side (the viewer's left), is a coiled fire hose. The lower part of the circular plinth displays a decorative band featuring a repeated rosette and scrollwise pattern. The entire composition is rendered in shades of grey and black on a plain, lightly toned background.
title: Statue
